meta.title: Identity — keep your documents valid and correct
meta.description: Check whether your Aadhaar, PAN and Voter ID agree, and learn how to fix them. In English, Kannada, Hindi and Urdu.

brand.name: identity
brand.unit: A unit of Islamic Information Centre

trust.heading: Why you can trust us
trust.disclaimer: Identity is a community help service of Islamic Information Centre. We are not a government office. All applications are submitted on official government portals, and fees are paid only to the issuing authority. We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.
trust.otpWarning: Identity will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.
trust.notGovernment: We are not a government office.
trust.officialOnly: We link only to official government portals.
trust.feesToAuthority: Fees are paid only to the issuing authority.

home.title: Are your documents in agreement?
home.intro: Small differences between your Aadhaar, PAN and Voter ID — a spelling, a date, an old address — can block bank KYC, scholarships, pensions and voting. Check yours in about 3 minutes.
home.privacy: Nothing you type leaves your phone.
home.assistedText: A trained Identity volunteer can help you at the help desk, on a WhatsApp video call or at a community camp.

start.heading: Before we start
start.privacy: Everything you type stays on this phone. We never ask for Aadhaar, PAN or EPIC numbers, OTPs or photos.
start.ownPhoneYes: Yes — keep my result on this phone

doc.heading: Your {document}
doc.hint: Type the details exactly as printed in English on the card. Leave a box empty if you are not sure.
doc.name: Name as on {document}
doc.yearOnly: Only the year is printed on the card
doc.locality: Area or locality on the card
doc.invalidDate: This date does not exist. Check the day, month and year.

situation.heading: A few quick questions
situation.livesAtAddress: Do you still live at the address on your documents?
situation.mobileLinked: Is a mobile number linked to your Aadhaar?
situation.mobileLinkedHint: This is the number that receives Aadhaar OTPs.
situation.documentsUpdated: Have you updated your Aadhaar documents (proof of identity and address) in the last 10 years?

result.heading: Your document health
result.allValid: Your documents agree with each other. Remember to keep them up to date.
result.planIntro: Do these in order. Each step links to the official site.
result.feeUnknown: Check the current fee on the official site.

result.rechecking: We are re-checking this information — please confirm on the official site.
result.variantNote: Banks, scholarships and PAN–Aadhaar linking usually need exactly the same spelling on every document.
result.notSaved: Not saved — you told us this is not your own phone.
result.cleared: Your Health Check has been removed from this phone.

reason.transliteration: Your name is spelt differently on {document} and {reference}.
reason.word_order: The parts of your name are in a different order on {document}.

reason.missing_or_extra_part: Part of your name is missing or extra on {document} compared with {reference}.

reason.year_only: {document} shows only your year of birth.
reason.year_differs: The year of birth on {document} is different from {reference}.
reason.gender_differs: The gender on {document} is different from {reference}.
reason.address_differs: The address on {document} is different from {reference}.

tip.check_mobile_link: Not sure if a mobile is linked to your Aadhaar? You can check on the myAadhaar portal or at an Aadhaar centre.
tip.check_document_update: Not sure when you last updated your Aadhaar documents? You can check on the myAadhaar portal.
tip.check_address: If you have moved, update your address — Aadhaar first, then your Voter ID.

help.title: Get assisted help
help.intro: A trained Identity volunteer can help you at the help desk, on a WhatsApp video call, at a community camp, or at home for elderly people and people with disabilities.
help.soon: Online booking is coming soon. Until then, please visit the Identity help desk at Islamic Information Centre, Bengaluru.
help.bring: Bring your original documents. If an OTP is needed, you will type it yourself.
